pages.title: Lunch Without a Hand
pages.text: Learn the actual marine-predator feeding route without inventing taming.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Drop one piece in the water near the shark and move away. Version 1.0.7 eats dropped food rather than hand right-click feeding. Meat food is accepted; the whole dropped item entity is discarded, so drop one at a time. This does not tame or promise healing.
